secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase Web API key (Firebase console → Project settings → General → Web API key). Needed for Firestore/auth features to work.

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Firebase project ID. Optional; the app has a built-in default.

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Firebase App ID. Optional; the app has a built-in default.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key (Google AI Studio). Optional; only used if the app calls Gemini.
